## Checklist

- [ ] `just format && just lint && just test-affected` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed packages have README, BUILD.bazel, tests, and owner
- [ ] Dependency laws respected (BLUEPRINT.md section 7); no new exceptions without an ADR
- [ ] Protocol changes are backward compatible or carry an approved migration plan
- [ ] No datasets, weights, generated output, or secrets added to Git
- [ ] Docs / model cards / dataset cards updated where affected
